preconditions.description: The number of strings k and length n satisfy the given bounds and total length constraint.

preconditions.expression: len(strings) == k and all(len(s) == n and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s) for s in strings)
preconditions.description: There are exactly k strings, each of length n, consisting only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: output == '-1' or (len(output) == n and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in output) and all(any(output[i] == s[j] and output[j] == s[i] and output[i:] == s[:i] + s[j] + s[i+1:j] + s[i] + s[j+1:] if i != j else False for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n)) for s in strings))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, output is a string of length n with lowercase letters such that every input string can be obtained from it by swapping exactly two characters at different indices; otherwise output is '-1'.
